description: This Java class represents the response to a RetrieveFeatureProperty command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates details about the feature property retrieved from a thing, including identifiers and the property value, and provides serialization/deserialization methods.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturePropertyResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to a RetrieveFeatureProperty command, containing feature ID, property pointer, property value, and related metadata.
